native.storage: C-order 2D or 3-channel, native bool/uint8/float32/float64; owned, directly bounded contiguous ndarray-owner view, or immutable bytes owner. At most 2^22 pixels.
native.coordinates: Inclusive integer rectangles, validated ROI offset, Python lists/tuples in unsampled calls or one-dimensional owned object arrays and concrete 4D int64 arrays. Empty geometry keeps a fresh image. Source width and height are not read.
native.arithmetic: Draw features and rectangles in provider order, starting negative. Wrap in-bounds negative indices and blend each indexed pixel once per rectangle. Float32 image product is rounded before float64 color sum and final float32 assignment.
native.bounds: Maximum 4096 features, 16 rectangles per feature, and 16 total for float32 or 128 otherwise. Ordinary finite nonzero float magnitudes 2^-24 through 10^6 or zero; three bounded RGB palette entries; alpha 0, 1, or [0.25,0.75].
native.workers: Ordered serial native operation, no artificial SIMD or threading dispatch.

providers.numpy: default_rng and integer population choice without replacement after bounded coordinate preparation. Exact seeded order and Generator state verified in both pinned profiles, including same-size permutation and error-before-blend.
providers.compatibility: Original fallback before any RNG/callback replay for unsupported geometry, storage, palettes, alpha, providers or protocols. Out-of-range index exceptions and modern/minimum RandomState differences stay provider-compatible.

parity: For frozen successful calls exact raw output bytes, dtype, shape, strides, ownership, incoming image content and Generator states; malformed calls exact error/non-fallback warning text and available callback traces.

timing.boundary: Public call including provider RNG, output allocation, conversion and blend. Seeded case uses two identical-seeded independent generators, each advancing naturally.
